column1: # The suite modes CI runs, one row per mode and surface: the cases the run
# runs. .github/workflows/tx-ecosystem-modes.yml runs each row weekly and on
# demand through scripts/checks/tx-ecosystem-mode.sh, which fetches the content
# the mode needs; scripts/checks/tx-ecosystem.sh fails a run whose count differs
# from its row, and scripts/checks/conformance-badges.sh draws its badge.
